title: EP 35 — EXPORT A CHAT
sub: Save the conversation to a plain-text file
lines: Need a record of the chat?
Need a record of what Clawd just did? The slash export command saves the conversation as plain text.
Pass a filename and Clawd writes the whole conversation straight to that file. No dialog.
You get the full transcript. Your prompts and Clawd's replies, in order.
Run slash export with no filename and it opens a dialog instead. Copy to clipboard, or save.
Drop the file in a P R, a ticket, or a teammate's inbox. Reproducible context, not a screenshot.
